meta.tagline: Heavy equipment, spare parts and workshop repairs since 1995
meta.description: DWAHI-ALBADIA, Al-Awhi Industrial Area, Sohar: new and used heavy equipment, spare parts, and repair of diesel engines, hydraulics and transmissions.

home.heroTitle: Heavy equipment, parts and repairs from a workshop that knows your machine
home.heroText: Since 1995 we have repaired diesel engines, hydraulics and transmissions for every kind of machine, and sold new and used equipment and parts.

services.title: Workshop repairs
services.intro: We take in complete machines or standalone components at our workshop in Al-Awhi Industrial Area, Sohar. We do not offer on-site service at the moment.

list.title: Diesel engines
list.text: Full repair and rebuild, and engine repowering.

list.title: Hydraulics
list.text: Pumps and cylinders of every type, with cylinders sourced from Syria, Europe and the GCC.

list.title: Tipper systems
list.text: Supply and installation of 2XL and 3XL jacks and pumps on dump trucks, with a one-year warranty.

list.title: Computer diagnostics
list.text: Electrical and electronic fault finding before repair.
